book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 KORIN Pol pepa muno namba 1 bogl Korin yomba tongwa

content: Israel yomba okuna ka kra mina yangesi mereyegl nono yangesi dinamuniwo

Angrima wagle, ene aglau ere dinaglmedi na diga: Nono kowano wagle prapra okuna konbauna ombunodi tenambuka pre God kamkua ta endungo pamara ye atnekra wan wu ana ye prapra wakai yene mundi nigl gogl ende koglo wingwa.
Te ye prapra Moses epiglma moraglkwa pre ana kamkua ya mundi nigl i mina baptais erikwa.
Ana ye prapra kaiya moknamo i keunde tongo neingwa,
te spirit i keunde niglmo tongo neingwa, spirit kombuglo i ye akiye wan wingwa. Ana kombuglo i Krais.
Ba ye mina yomba merkinde mambunono kinde eriko God wakai pir tekruko ana ye geglko nangino briye makan waule bange bange paingwa.
Ana taragl yeglmere plau dungwa i nono kanpogl sinamga pre ombunodi norkwa. Ye taragl kinde pre bumbuno geglmere yegl nono ama bumbuno goglkramga.

Te god kimbi mambunomo ye sika simere yegl nono ama god kimbi mambuno sika sikramga. I kamambuno pepa mina yegl beglko pangwa: “Yomba amedi mogl kaiya mokna ya nigl nendre ana andigl katno engre mambuno guagua erikwa.”
Te ye mina yaglambu tau kunogl gundimere yegl nono ama yegl erekramga. Ye yegl eremeglko ana ande enge suwarata ye mina yomba 23,000 geglkwa.
Nono Yaglkande, ta eran kanamnedi yeikramniwo, Israel yomba tau yegl eriko ana toki giugl kaiglko ye geglkwa.
Ana ene mawa tawa ka di God tekriyo, Israel yomba tau yegl eriko ana yomba sigogl gogl orkwa angelo wu ye sigoglkwa.

Taragl prapra ye mina plaudi tongwa i taragl yegl okuwo plau dinambuka ipre ombunodi yomba tau tongwa. Te nono yegl ere dinaglmedi pre kamambuno pepa mina i beglkwa. Sraglpre, kamun makan dundinambuka enge mangigl orkwa.
Yeglpre yomba ta yene andigl giglendi moledi piran ana yene suglmo wakai moglo do, aglau eran ye yangesi dinambiwo.

Ana bagl nusi ene mina plaudi tongwa i bagl nusi kane ta manga. Taman. Bagl nusi kuno yegl yomba prapra mina plaudi tomere ama ene mina plau dungwa. Te God yene ka digidi panduglmere erambuka, i ye ta kanwinge eran bagl nusi ene mina plau dingwa i suwarata ene yomburo engre atne endekrambuka. Taman. bagl nusi ene mina ta plaudi tenan ana God ene akeple dinambuka pre konbauna sitenambuka. Konbauna i yegl: Ye ere endinan ene andigl giglendi meglmbi ana bagl nusi i ene ta engre atne endekrambuka.
Yaglkande kaiya moknamo nendre ana god kimbi kaiya moknamo nekramga
Ipre na angrima kaima wagle, god kimbi pre dembiye karaugl ere tenaglmara i ene teke ende eglke piyo.
Ene pirpogl singwa yomba na ka i diteinga. Na ka diga i enene yumbusi piryo.

Ana Yaglkande kaiya moknamo nemara nigl mingi i God blesingmo pangwa; nono diwakai yeitendre ana nomga, i Krais bormaimo kaima nendre ana ye bogl wu suwara omuno? Ana bret bukondi nemara i Krais nangiye kaima nendre ana ye bogl wu suwara omuno?
Te bret suwara kaima yongwa. Ana nono yomba merkinde bret suwara i diure nendre ana wu yomba suwara omga.
Israel yomba taragl erikwa i ene piryo. Alta mina ofa erikwa i yomba nendre ana alta i mina taragl erikwa i Godmo bogl ye wu suwara eingwa.
Na ka sragl we diye? “God kimbi i kaima mo ofa teingwa i kaima ne?” Na yegl diyo?
Tamanga. Na ka yegl diga, “Yomba Bina taragl ofa, i ere spirit kinde wagle teingwa. Ye ofa i ere God tekrikwa.” Ipre na pirka ene spirit kinde wagle bogl makaisi wu suwara pikraglkwa.
Ene Yaglkande nigl mingmo mina nendre te spirit kinde wagle nigl mingno mina akiye nekraglkwa. Ana Yaglkande boglmo mina kaiya mokna nendre te spirit kinde wagle botno mina akiye nekraglkwa.
Nono Yaglkande dem kumbrambedi eramun kana? Nono yomburo pai mitna ende ye yombuglo engre atne endum kana?
Nono engenge God kangiye dimitna endinamga
“Nono taragl kanekane eramga pangwa,” ye yegl dingwa. I kaima dingwa, ba taragl prapra wakai paikrukwa. “Nono taragl kanekane eramga pangwa,” ba taragl i prapra nono ta akeple kaima dikrukwa.
Enene wakai moglpai eraglkwa ipre pirkraglkwa, ba yomba tau wakai moglpai eraglkwa ipre piryo.
Ana bugla-kambu miye kanekane maket erikwa i pra ene i-ninaglkwa, ba ene nomano suwo yei ka kra kanekane poglkriyo.
Te kamambuno pepa dungwa i nono pirkan ounga, “Makan ya taragl prapra makan mina paingwa i Yaglkande taragl-nem moglkwa.”
Kamambuno kiurikwa yomba ta kaiya mokna akiye ninamnedi ene digaran embi ana ye kaiya mokna kanekane ereyenambuka i ana ene nomano suwo yei krapoglkre yoko neiyo.
Ba yomba ta eremogl kaiya mokna i god kimbi ofamo mina tengura-wa dinan, ye ka ditongwa yomba i, ya te ye nomanemo undinan ana taraglmo i nekraglkwa,

ana ditongwa yomba i nomanemo undinan pre na diga ba ene nomane kinde erambuka ipre na ta dikrika ipre ene nekraglkwa. Sraglpre, na taragl kanekane ta ninagledi piraglmere i ninaglka kuno orkwa. Ba yomba ta sraglpre na mambunona i ye nomanemo mina yumbu sume?
Kaiya mokna ipre na God diwakai yeitendre neimbo, ana God diwakai yeite neinga ipre, yomba ta sraglpre na nangina ka-sinambe?
Yeglpre ene kaiya mokna ya nigl nendre te sragl ta eraglkwa, i God kangiye dembiyesi mitna ende ama eraglkwa.
Ana Juda yomba ya Grik yomba ya te God yombama ipre ene poglodi pirtre, ana ye tandaglme mina yange sinaglkwa embriye i erekraglmiwo.

Na ombugl kuno yegl erika: Taragl kanekane erika i yomba prapra na mambunona i wakai piraglmedi erika, ba na nana wakai moragledi pre erekrika. Te God yomba prapra ere-inambuka ipre na yomba wakai ere akepledi tendre kongun erika.

footnotes.text: Kamambuno pepa tau Moses kongun ormere ipre kamo boglo pangwa. Ka bange suwo Israel yomba ye nigl eremogl kombuglo mina ungo neingwa kamo buglo i pangwa. Kamo ta Kisim Bek mina numa 17:1-17 te Namba 20:1-8 pango orkwa. Ka suwo pambrika i Juda yomba pirkwa kombuglo suwarata mina nigl ungo neimedi pirkwa. Ana kombuglomo i Israel yomba bange bange eimara i akiye wu ikine ikine omedi pirkwa.
Grik yomba kanno mina ka epigl i ka mongo kaima ta wu pene pikrukwa.

Enge tau bugla-kambu sikei god kimbi kombuglange gagl tendre ana okuwo ipi maket topo bogl ingwa. Ba Pol yegl dungwa, yomba tau God yombama, buglamo miye ta topo eraglkwa i ta pirkriyo, buglamo nomun ana aglau ounedi ta pirkriyo.
Grik kanno mina ka i mongomo kaima ta wu pene pikrukwa.
